content.text:
I read the brief against the release line by line. Here's what I found.

**Overall:** The reported P&L and segment figures are accurate, including basis labels (the brief correctly tags the 23% constant currency figure as non-GAAP). Three problems: the cash flow story is missing entirely (negative free cash flow of $(5,855)M on $(44,924)M of capex, and zero buybacks in the quarter versus $(13,238)M a year ago), the brief never quantifies the $6.26 per-share contribution of the equity gain even though it leads with a 294% EPS increase, and two places mislabel the $98.0B other income figure as a "net gain on equity securities" (the equity securities line was $99.0B; $98.0B is total other income, net). The watch item also implies the $20.3B notes carry an AI-infrastructure use of proceeds; the release says general corporate purposes for the notes.

facts.evidence: Consolidated revenues increased 24% year-over-year to $119.8 billion; the release notes this is the 12th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.
Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% to $112.1 billion, and diluted EPS increased 294% to $9.11.
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion, driven by growth in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure.
Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion, led by 17% growth in Google Search & other and 15% in Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices.
Operating income increased 30% to $40.8 billion, with operating margin expanding by 2 percentage points to 34%.

Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily resulting from net unrealized gains on equity securities. [Note: the $98.0B and its cause are stated correctly, but the brief never states the $6.26 per-share effect of the equity securities gain disclosed in the OI&E footnote, despite leading with the 294% EPS increase.]
Google Cloud operating income increased to $8.8 billion from $2.8 billion in the prior year period.

In June 2026, the company issued Class A and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion for general corporate purposes, including AI infrastructure capital expenditures.

claims.claim: Alphabet Q2 2026 revenues grew 24% to $119.8 billion.
Revenue growth was driven by an 82% surge in Google Cloud.
Revenue growth was driven by a $98.0 billion net gain on equity securities.
claims.note: The equity gain sits in other income (expense), net and is not a component of revenues, so it cannot drive the 24% revenue growth. Separately, the release puts the equity securities net gain at $99,031M ($99.0B); $98.0B is total other income, net.

claims.claim: The release notes this is Alphabet's 12th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.
Non-GAAP constant currency revenues increased 23% year-over-year.
Constant currency revenues exclude the effect of foreign exchange rate movements and hedging activities.
Operating income increased 30% to $40.8 billion.
Operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.
Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% to $112.1 billion.
Diluted EPS increased 294% to $9.11.
Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily resulting from net unrealized gains on equity securities.
Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion.
Google Services growth was led by 17% growth in Google Search & other and 15% in Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices.
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion.
Google Cloud growth was driven by growth in Google Cloud Platform across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure.
Google Cloud operating income increased to $8.8 billion from $2.8 billion in the prior year period.
Alphabet-level activities primarily reflect expenses related to shared AI research and development.
Alphabet-level activities resulted in a loss of $5.8 billion in the quarter.
The release does not provide specific financial guidance or outlook figures for future periods.
Management stated that AI investments are redefining what is possible across the business.
Nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 use Gemini Enterprise.
Gemini models process 22 billion API tokens per minute.
The Gemini App has 950 million monthly active users.
In June 2026 the company issued Class A and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion.
The equity raise proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including AI infrastructure capital expenditures.
The company issued senior unsecured notes for net proceeds of $20.3 billion in the second quarter of 2026.
Total cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities increased to $242.5 billion as of June 30, 2026, from $126.8 billion as of December 31, 2025.
The $98.0 billion net gain was a gain on equity securities.
claims.note: Mislabels the line. The release reports gain on equity securities, net of $99,031M ($99.0B) for Q2 2026; the $98.0B (97,983) figure is other income (expense), net, which the release describes as primarily the result of the equity gains.

claims.claim: The release notes this could significantly contribute to the volatility of Other Income (Expense) in future periods.
The $49.6 billion equity raise carries a stated use for scaling AI infrastructure and global compute.
The $20.3 billion senior unsecured notes issuance carries a stated use for scaling AI infrastructure and global compute.
claims.note: The release states the notes' net proceeds are 'to be used for general corporate purposes' with no mention of AI infrastructure or compute; that stated use attaches only to the equity raise.

claims.claim: Under the At-the-Market Program the company may sell up to $40.0 billion of Class A and Class C stock.
No shares had been sold under the ATM Program as of June 30, 2026.
